headword: {終身雇用制|しゅうしんこようせい}
reading: しゅうしんこようせい

definitions.explanation: A Japanese employment practice in which workers are hired straight out of school and remain with one company until retirement.

examples.japanese: {終身雇用制|しゅうしんこようせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧だ。
examples.english: The lifetime employment system is a traditional Japanese way of working.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{終身雇用制|しゅうしんこようせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{崩|くず}れ→崩れる：04248_kuzureru⟧つつ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Recently it is said that the lifetime employment system is breaking down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大企業|だいきぎょう}→大企業：12277_daikigyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{終身雇用制|しゅうしんこようせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{根強|ねづよ}く→根強い：13106_nezuyoi⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{若|わか}い⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}→当たり前：01685_atarimae⟧になってきた。
examples.english: In large corporations, the lifetime employment system still remains deeply rooted, but among the younger generation, changing jobs has become commonplace.

notes:
One of the three pillars of traditional Japanese corporate culture, along with ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧ (seniority-based promotion) and {企業別組合|きぎょうべつくみあい} (company-based unions). Under this system, employees join a company after graduating and stay until ⟦{定年|ていねん}→定年：07500_teinen⟧ (mandatory retirement age), in exchange for job security and gradually increasing pay.

This practice became widespread during Japan's postwar economic boom but has been declining since the 1990s as globalization, economic stagnation, and changing attitudes have made job-hopping more common.
